scope: Evaluation-speed implementation and bounded comparison only. No learning or policy-quality claim.
model_search: No .pt/.pth files were found under outputs/v7 or outputs/v6. Existing v4 crane files use a different input contract; no weight conversion was performed.

smoke.purpose: Integration check during implementation before final commit. Excluded from campaign performance estimates.

campaign.controls: One fresh process at a time; fixed model per paired input; no simultaneous test/training workload.
campaign.timing_scope: Decision timing excludes trace hashing and action application. Total wall timing includes observer overhead.
campaign.known_limits: Default candidate budget retains mandatory overflow. Daily input count is requested trucks, not necessarily admitted trucks.
